title: Quantum ESPRESSO tutorial campaign artifact and learning review
status_detail: Blocked until every planned simulation has an executed, failed, or deliberate-deferral disposition.
objective: Review all campaign dispositions and actual artifacts, identify transferable execution and extraction behavior, and recommend which tutorial routes to retain, repeat, or defer.
authorized_scope: Compare source plans with actual stage records, snapshots, streams, runtimes, and artifact inventories.
Classify observed artifacts, failures, restart behavior, reusable parser opportunities, and explicit deferrals.
Propose compact sanitized provenance for separate review without moving or deleting calculation data.
completion_criteria: Every child has an explicit evidence-backed disposition.
Reusable silicon/QE/Wannier findings are separated from unrelated-material and out-of-scope learning.
The review identifies follow-up candidates without activating them or claiming scientific validation.
exclusions: The review does not execute calculations, delete or relocate data, or activate successors.
Cross-tutorial numerical comparison is prohibited without explicit compatibility.
Passing tutorial runs do not establish production readiness or scientific acceptance.
